new=""""No live Telegram or Bridge calls; SQLite and idempotency contract tests."""
import unittest, tempfile, os
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch
import daemon
from daemon import key, persist, offset, open_db, mark, config, Blocked, receive, deliver

class GatewayTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temp=tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.store=open_db({"db":str(Path(self.temp.name)/"work.sqlite3")})
        self.c={"chatid":1234,"userid":1234,"base":"http://127.0.0.1:17448",
            "CURATOR_MANAGED_CHAT_ID":"tg-curator-owner",
            "CURATOR_REPOSITORY":"foto6/boss",
            "CURATOR_BRANCH":"agent/telegram-curator-authority-20261012",
            "CURATOR_EXPECTED_HEAD":"773b42f59018a2e55834b87275796486d686e4f6"}
    def tearDown(self):
        self.store.close()
        self.temp.cleanup()
    def test_duplicate_update_persists_exactly_once(self):
        persist(self.store,42,7,"first")
        persist(self.store,42,7,"duplicate")
        self.assertEqual(offset(self.store),43)
        self.assertEqual([r["body"] for r in self.store.execute("SELECT body FROM inbox")],["first"])
    def test_offset_does_not_decrease(self):
        persist(self.store,10,1,"hi");persist(self.store,6,1,None)
        self.assertEqual(offset(self.store),11)
    def test_unknown_stays_unknown(self):
        persist(self.store,10,1,"task");mark(self.store,10,"SENDING_UNKNOWN")
        self.assertEqual(self.store.execute("SELECT state FROM inbox WHERE update_id=10").fetchone()["state"],"SENDING_UNKNOWN")
    def test_stable_dedup_key(self):self.assertEqual(key(123),"telegram-curator-123")
    def test_no_configuration_fails_closed(self):
        with patch.dict(os.environ,{"CURATOR_SECRET_FILE":str(Path(self.temp.name)/"nonexistent.dpapi")},clear=True):
            with self.assertRaises(Blocked):config()
    def test_wrong_telegram_sender_rejected(self):
        update={"update_id":18,"message":{"message_id":11,"text":"/task do it",
                 "chat":{"id":1234},"from":{"id":9999}}}
        with patch.object(daemon,"notify") as n:
            receive(self.store,self.c,update)
            self.assertEqual(self.store.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) c FROM inbox").fetchone()["c"],0)
            n.assert_not_called()
    def test_authorized_task_is_durable_and_acknowledged(self):
        update={"update_id":19,"message":{"message_id":11,"text":"/task verify CI",
                "chat":{"id":1234},"from":{"id":1234}}}
        with patch.object(daemon,"notify") as n:
            receive(self.store,self.c,update)
            self.assertEqual(self.store.execute("SELECT body FROM inbox").fetchone()["body"],"verify CI")
            n.assert_called_once()
    def test_unknown_outcome_never_resends(self):
        persist(self.store,22,1,"do not replay");mark(self.store,22,"SENDING_UNKNOWN")
        with patch.object(daemon,"find_assignment",return_value=None),patch.object(daemon,"send_once") as send:
            deliver(self.store,self.c)
            send.assert_not_called()
            self.assertEqual(self.store.execute("SELECT state FROM inbox").fetchone()["state"],"NEEDS_RECONCILIATION")
    def test_blocked_assignment_no_replay(self):
        persist(self.store,24,1,"blocked");mark(self.store,24,"QUEUED","id24")
        assignment={"id":"id24","state":"blocked","dispatchCount":0}
        with patch.object(daemon,"find_assignment",return_value=assignment),patch.object(daemon,"send_once") as send,patch.object(daemon,"notify"):
            deliver(self.store,self.c)
            send.assert_not_called()
            self.assertEqual(self.store.execute("SELECT state FROM inbox").fetchone()["state"],"BLOCKED")
    def test_queued_receipt_not_conflated_with_send(self):
        persist(self.store,25,1,"queued");mark(self.store,25,"QUEUED","id25")
        assignment={"id":"id25","state":"queued","dispatchCount":0,"dispatchSubmitAttempted":False}
        with patch.object(daemon,"find_assignment",return_value=assignment),patch.object(daemon,"notify") as n:
            deliver(self.store,self.c)
            self.assertEqual(self.store.execute("SELECT state FROM inbox").fetchone()["state"],"QUEUED")
            n.assert_not_called()


class ProxyTransportTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_http_connect_url_parses(self):
        from telegram_transport import parse_proxy
        self.assertEqual(parse_proxy("http://127.0.0.1:3128").scheme,"http")
    def test_socks5h_url_parses(self):
        from telegram_transport import parse_proxy
        self.assertEqual(parse_proxy("socks5h://127.0.0.1:1080").scheme,"socks5h")
    def test_mtproto_rejected(self):
        from telegram_transport import parse_proxy, ProxyTransportError
        with self.assertRaises(ProxyTransportError):
            parse_proxy("tg://proxy?server=example.org&port=1443")
    def test_no_proxy_is_allowed(self):
        from telegram_transport import parse_proxy
        self.assertIsNone(parse_proxy(""))
    def test_unsupported_proxy_rejected(self):
        from telegram_transport import parse_proxy, ProxyTransportError
        with self.assertRaises(ProxyTransportError):
            parse_proxy("ftp://127.0.0.1:1080")
    def test_transport_refuses_non_bot_api_host(self):
        from telegram_transport import open_telegram, ProxyTransportError
        from urllib.request import Request
        with self.assertRaises(ProxyTransportError):
            open_telegram(Request("https://example.com"),proxy=None)
    def test_no_invalid_proxy_port(self):
        from telegram_transport import parse_proxy, ProxyTransportError
        with self.assertRaises(ProxyTransportError):
            parse_proxy("socks5h://127.0.0.1:65536")

if __name__=="__main__":unittest.main()
